title: GeoSkill:Experience-Driven Hierarchical Skill Learning with Collaborative Revision forGeospatialAgents
abstract: arXiv:2609.13667v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Geospatial agents are increasingly expected to support recurring and evolving analytical tasks rather than execute isolated workflows. In such settings, effective agents must distill prior execution experience into reusable geospatial procedural knowledge to guide future planning and tool use. However, existing memory-augmented paradigms struggle to summarize both long-horizon tool-chain orchestration experience and tool-level invocation constraints in geospatial analysis, while directly relying on LLM self-reflection to update experience often leads to misattribution and unreliable revisions. translated_title: GeoSkill：面向地理空间智能体的经验驱动层次化技能学习与协同修订方法
translated_abstract: 地理空间智能体日益被期望能够支持重复性和不断演化的分析任务，而不仅仅是执行孤立的工作流。在此类场景下，有效的智能体必须将先前的执行经验提炼为可复用的地理空间程序性知识，以指导未来的规划与工具使用。然而，现有的记忆增强范式难以同时总结地理空间分析中长时程工具链编排经验和工具级调用约束，而直接依赖大语言模型（LLM）自我反思来更新经验往往会导致错误归因和不可靠的修订。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了GeoSkill，一种面向地理空间智能体的经验驱动层次化技能学习框架。GeoSkill包含两个核心组件：（i）层次化技能库（HSB），由规划技能库和工具技能库组成，分别提炼高层任务规划经验和工具使用约束……
tldr: GeoSkill提出了一种面向地理空间智能体的经验驱动层次化技能学习框架，通过包含规划技能库和工具技能库的层次化技能库以及协同修订机制，将执行经验提炼为可复用的程序性知识，从而有效支持重复性和不断演化的地理空间分析任务。
en_tdlr: GeoSkill is an experience-driven hierarchical skill learning framework for geospatial agents that distills execution experience into reusable procedural knowledge through a Hierarchical Skill Bank (comprising Planning and Tool Skill Banks) with collaborative revision, enabling effective support for recurring and evolving geospatial analytical tasks.
